notes.title: 1.00c Patch Notes (13.4.2025)
notes.content:
[list]

[*]Fixed the problems with full screen / windowed mode configuration when launching the game for the first time.
[*]Fixed the trees not being choppable when launching the game for the first time. Do note that player accuracy is not 100% at the start so you may still miss the trees when starting out.
[*]Fixed the freezing / crash when an ability was activated without any other abilities unlocked.
[*]Added autosave feature. The game will now automatically save every 5 minutes in addition to saving when sacrificing logs and quitting from the main menu.

[/list]
